newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly firmer on weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly firmer on weak yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures, except for the spot June contract, ended firmer on Monday, as the yen's weakness against the dollar led to moderate short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.7 yen higher. Benchmark November was up 0.4 yen at 128.3 yen.
Activity was sluggish as most players retreated to the sidelines ahead of the spot expiry on Tuesday.
"The yen's retreat helped most prices move into positive territory by the close. But the topside will be limited amid continuing bearish sentiment," one trader said.
